site.name: SixSheet
site.tagline: The spoiler-free GTA VI cheat sheet

launch.note: Counting down to midnight ET, the US store listing time. Rockstar Support confirms a midnight-local launch on Nov 19 in every region on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, starting in New Zealand. In the US, the store timestamp means Central, Mountain and Pacific players may unlock before their own midnight.

facts.label: Unlock time
facts.value: Rockstar Support confirms midnight local time on Nov 19 in every region, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. New Zealand goes first; US store listings show midnight Eastern (05:00 UTC).

facts.label: Platforms
facts.value: PS5, Xbox Series X and Series S. No PC version announced.

facts.label: Xbox Cloud Gaming
facts.value: Playable day one via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Series consoles, starting at 1 a.m. ET on November 19. Streams at Series S settings; the game is sold separately.

facts.label: Performance
facts.value: Rockstar says the game targets 30 fps on every console. PS5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling for a sharper image plus ray-traced shadows that only the Pro gets. Remote Play works on both PlayStation and Xbox.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: Standard $79.99 / Ultimate $99.99 (Ultimate Upgrade $20 on the US Xbox Store)

facts.label: Physical copies
facts.value: Code in a box. No disc at launch. Rockstar says boxed copies are available starting November 12 so you can redeem and pre-load. There is no physical Ultimate Edition.

facts.label: Download size
facts.value: Up to 212 GB, depending on console

facts.label: Pre-load
facts.value: Digital pre-load started November 10: midnight local time on PS5, and 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox. Redeem a code-in-box copy as soon as you have it (retail availability from November 12).

facts.label: First update
facts.value: Version 1.002 started rolling out in stages on November 13, about 1 GB on PS5. Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes. Let it install before launch night.

facts.label: Second update
facts.value: Version 1.002.001 began rolling out November 16: about 600 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S. PS5 gets it in stages, so check again if it hasn't shown up yet. Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes.

facts.label: Early-purchase bonus
facts.value: Vintage Vice City Pack: a '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage, outfits and hairstyles, and an exclusive weapon pattern. Included with purchases before Nov 20. Digital editions also include one month of GTA+.

facts.label: Free map and poster
facts.value: From Nov 19, Rockstar's official GTA VI site will offer a free printable cover-art poster and Leonida map. A double-sided printed version follows on the Rockstar Store shortly after launch for $0.99, or free with any store order.

facts.label: Review score
facts.value: Metacritic average of 99 from about 145 critic reviews when the review embargo lifted at the New Zealand unlock, tying the highest score on the site.

facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: 61 cheats. All unlock after the story; most also need a challenge. Open the phone (Up), hold L1 (LB), press R1 (RB), then enter the D-pad code. Using one turns off saving and trophies/achievements for that session.

prep.detail: Xbox Series S 512 GB owners: expect to delete a couple of big games.
Digital pre-load has been open since November 10. Done when the game tile shows a countdown instead of a Play button. If you have a code-in-box copy, redeem it as soon as it arrives.

prep.text: Buy before Nov 20 for the Vice City Pack
prep.detail: Both editions include it. Digital copies also include one month of GTA+; claim it on the GTA+ page, and cancel if you do not want it to continue as a paid plan.

prep.text: Check your account region's unlock time
prep.detail: Your platform account region sets the unlock. Changing the console clock does nothing.

prep.text: Mute spoiler words on X, Reddit and YouTube
prep.detail: Earlier time zones unlock up to 19 hours before the Americas. Streams of the opening will be everywhere.

prep.text: Keep the console on and updated
prep.detail: Two updates have rolled out so far: 1.002 from November 13 and 1.002.001 from November 16, and more may follow. Leave the console on, or in Rest or Sleep mode with auto-updates on, and check for updates again on November 18. PS5 owners: system software 26.07-14.23.00 (security fixes) is also out, so install it before unlock (playstation.com/support).

finds.title: A funny Easter egg waits at the top of a tall tower
finds.summary: A long climb ends at a nest of painted eggs, and throwing one off the top gets a comic reaction from someone down below. The climb takes about seven minutes. Confirmed on video by several players, including xGarbett, elrubius and Jynxzi.
finds.source: xGarbett on X, covered by GameSpot (Eddie Makuch); also shown on stream by elrubius and Jynxzi

finds.title: Tiny animation details in the Guardian's hands-on preview
finds.summary: Jason can take bites of a donut in one hand while sipping a beer with the other. When he breaks into a run with a six-pack, he hikes it into the crook of his arm and the drinks slosh inside the bottles. Seen in a Rockstar-led demo, not yet checked by players.

finds.title: Collectible trading cards: 18 sets, 480 cards
finds.summary: Trading cards are hidden all over the map, on shelves, walls, phone boxes and tool boxes. There are 18 sets covering fictional sports teams, comics and more. Once selling unlocks, pawn shops buy them for roughly $20 up to $1,000+ depending on rarity, and selling a card doesn't remove it from your collection.

finds.title: A goggle-wearing dog that drives a jet ski
finds.summary: Swim far enough out and you may find a dog in goggles sitting on a jet ski. Hop on and the dog keeps its paws on the handlebars while you ride along.
finds.source: ChizPlays on X, covered by Kotaku

finds.title: A familiar boat from GTA V
finds.summary: Michael's well-known yacht from GTA V shows up in Leonida, and its GPS screen shows a slice of the old Los Santos map. A fun nod for longtime fans.
finds.source: riff_gta on X; also listed by Sportskeeda

prepLive.detail: If the game offers an update when you open it, let it install before you start. The two pre-launch patches (1.002 and 1.002.001) should already be on your console.
Do it from the pause menu before you get going, so the opening looks and reads the way you want.

prepLive.text: Check for the Vintage Vice City Pack
prepLive.detail: Bought before Nov 20? The pack comes with your copy. If it's missing, contact Rockstar Support.

prepLive.text: Claim your free month of GTA+
prepLive.detail: Digital copies include one month of GTA+. Claim it on the GTA+ page, and cancel before it renews if you don't want to pay.

prepLive.text: Grab the free poster and map
prepLive.detail: Rockstar's official GTA VI site offers a free printable cover-art poster and Leonida map from Nov 19.
The opening hours will be all over X, Reddit and YouTube today. Keep your muted words on, and SixSheet's spoiler shield too.
